responsePromise: Quote back within a few hours, seven days a week.

process.detail: A few details and a photo or two is enough to get started. No forms to print, no site visit needed yet.
We measure up, check access and talk through what you actually want, then put a fixed price in writing.
You pick a start date. We turn up when we said we would and leave the place tidy.

faq.q: How much does a deck cost?
faq.a: Size, height off the ground and decking material drive it. Use the guide above for a range, then we confirm on site.
Timber is cheaper up front and wants oiling. Composite costs more and mostly does not. We will tell you what each really costs over ten years.
Low decks usually do not. Height, proximity to a boundary and a roof over it can change that. We will tell you what applies to yours.
Most home decks are under a week once materials are on site.
